mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stellar_user_address (user_id, consignee, phone, province, city, district, detail, is_default, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user) VALUES (#{userId}, #{consignee}, #{phone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detail}, #{isDefault}, #{createTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stellar_user_address WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stellar_user_address WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM stellar_user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE stellar_user_address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE stellar_user_address SET is_default = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
